Attack when the blade glows blue to chill the air and freeze your foe.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 20 |durability = 40 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Frostspear}} Frostspears are magical [[Weapon]]s forged with ancient [[Ice]] from the [[Hebra Mountains]]. They are found not only among those Mountains, but in [[Hyrule Field]] as well, particularly around [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. Due to their elemental nature, they belong to the [[Magic Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} When their blades glows blue, any attacks will freeze [[Link]]'s [[Enemy|Enemies]]. These attacks will immediately defeat [[Fire]]-related Enemies.{{Cite|{{Big|Elemental Weaknesses}}
If you use an icy attack against a fiery enemy, you may defeat it in one hit.|Tips and Tricks|BotW}} Equipping a Frostspear in a in high levels of [[Heat]] will also grant [[Link]] one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. One of the Weapons [[Nebb]] asks to see during "[[The Weapon Connoisseur]]" [[Side Quest]] is a Frostspear, which his grandfather looked for when he was younger.{{Cite|Have you heard of the {{Color BotW|Blue|frostspear}}? So...when my grandpa was young, he looked for it but couldn't find it. So please! If you find it, please let me see it!|Nebb|BotW}} If Link shows him a Frostspear, Nebb will be excited and give him a [[Gold Rupee]] as a reward.{{Cite|Isn't that the {{Color BotW|Blue|frostspear}}? So cool! Let me see!|Nebb|BotW}}{{Cite|Thanks for lettin' me see! Take this as a thank you!|Nebb|BotW}} Frostspears are made of metal, and as a result, they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, but they are incapable of burning when exposed to Fire or a [[Scorching Climate]].
